name: kyklos
description: Kyklos makes an AI coding agent follow a secure software development workflow: every change is a story with a specification, a branch, tests, a review and a written proof that each quality check passed, before it counts as done. Guards stop unsafe pushes, merges and closes; skills guide the agent; the Kyklos Bridge runs builds, tests and coverage on the host. Start with the guide inside the plugin (skill: Kyklos reference and troubleshooting).
